coverageNote.note: Costco runs ~24 US cross-dock depots (dry, refrigerated, and e-commerce) feeding ~600 US warehouses, plus a handful internationally. We audited 11 representative US depots spanning dry and wet cross-docks.

account.dossierIntro: Costco runs the leanest cross-dock model in retail. Freight lands at a depot, gets sorted, and ships to the warehouse within hours, so every minute a trailer waits at the gate stalls the whole flow. We mapped 11 of Costco's roughly 24 US depots: 1,685 dock doors and more than 5,300 trailer positions across dry and refrigerated cross-docks. YardFlow turns that gate-to-dock handoff into one orchestrated move.
surprisingFindings: Monrovia MD packs about 260 dock doors onto a single 84-acre cross-dock, a building sized so a trailer never has to sit.
Across 11 depots we counted room for more than 5,300 trailers and zero rail. Every load in or out moves by truck through the gate.
Costco's Monroe NJ site splits wet and dry into two separate gated depots 600m apart, so one store order clears two gate queues.

sites.dossierExcerpt:
The roster coordinates were correct. Geocoding resolved:
- 10 Costco Dr (DRY #175) → 40.3561728, -74.4553418 — exactly the roster point.
- 12 Costco Dr (WET #265) → 40.3562264, -74.4625090 — ~600 m WEST, a physically
  separate building.

Satellite at z15-z18 confirms the roster point lands on a single very large
light-gray-roofed cross-dock building wrapped by extensive trailer yards. A probe
at the wet-depot coordinates shows a distinct, separate building cluster to the
west, confirming the two are different structures. **This audit covers ONLY the
dry depot at 10 Costco Dr.** Web research (Chamber of Commerce, Loc8NearMe,
Panjiva) corroborates Dry Depot #175 as a trucker-facing distribution depot,
hours ~5:00 AM-2:30 PM Mon-Sat, "quick in-and-out for drivers."

fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully fenced (chain-link confirmed in Street View on the west perimeter) with a single controlled vehicular approach off Costco Drive at the NW. Standard Costco depot driver check-in operation. High confidence the property is gated/controlled; the gate barrier itself sits on the private interior road with no Street View and is partly tree-obscured from above.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from Costco depot operating standard (staffed driver check-in at the truck entrance) plus the fenced, single-throat approach. Could not positively resolve a distinct booth structure in satellite/Street View; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. This is a ~1M+ sq ft cross-dock; dock-leveler rhythm and backed-in trailers visible on the north face and along the building wings. dockDoorCount=220 is an order-of-magnitude overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Hundreds of trailers parked without tractors in dense fanned rows on the NE, SE and SW sides; dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Very deep internal approach and a large central maneuvering apron easily hold a 3+ truck queue inside the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Abundant unused paved width at the entrance throat and across the central apron to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town/exurban Monroe Township setting (golf course, residential subdivisions, wooded buffers and farmland adjacent); judged Rural per rubric tie-break, though it is a large industrial park.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single integrated cross-dock operation; docks ring one building, not two physically separate ship/rcv banks.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Audited the DRY depot building only (10 Costco Dr). The WET depot #265 at 12 Costco Dr is a separate building ~600m west and is NOT included here, so multipleFacilities=false for this geofence.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs in the wooded buffer south of the property but does not spur into the yard.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 112.1 acres derived from the perimeter polygon (fenced building + trailer yards).

citations.claim: Active Costco Wholesale Corporation requisition for 'Any Position in Monroe Township, New Jersey' (depot staffing).
FDA/govt site profile confirms the paired Monroe Township Costco depot complex operates as a self-run distribution facility.

verification.rationale: 10 Costco Dr is the dry-depot half (#175) of Costco's paired Monroe Township NE cross-dock complex (dry #175 at 10, wet #265 at 12); live by-appointment receiving + active Costco hiring; the Yelp 'CLOSED' tag is a stale crowd retail miscategorization, not a real closure.

sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster coords (40.758482, -112.032165) landed directly on the roof of a very
long, narrow north-south building inside the West-Valley / SLC International
industrial corridor off 300 South. Web research confirms the address as Costco's
SLC Distribution Center / Depot (appointment-only receiving 5:00a-12:30p Mon-Sat;
drivers check in and are issued a pager with their unload door number). The
center coordinate was nudged to the true footprint mid-point (40.75815,
-112.03230). The building is the long central structure; the large white-roofed
building to the southeast and the buildings to the west are separate tenants and
were excluded from the Costco perimeter.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off 300 South on the north side; wide paved throat funnels trucks to a manned gatehouse with a red canopy spanning the drive (visible in 2021-05 inner-yard Street View). Perimeter chain-link fencing confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Canopied check-in gatehouse in the entry throat with trucks queued at it; corroborated by published driver procedure (check in, receive a pager with the unload door number).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because the gate IS manned with a physical check-in booth, not a kiosk.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock: continuous dock-door rows on BOTH long faces (east and west) of the building; inbound and outbound run from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Both long faces are packed with dock doors for ~640m; west-face Street View shows a continuous wall of dock seals. Easily 50+; ~180 total is an honest overhead estimate across both faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards: a large east-side lot full of parked trailers, a north drop yard along 300 South, and a west-side yard. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron with multiple truck-widths of unused paved room at the gate; physical space to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated from the wide throat (~2 effective lanes inbound past the gatehouse); not lane-striped at the road.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in the truck path; left false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Overhead estimate from drop-yard area; approximate.

citations.claim: Active Costco Wholesale Corporation requisition 'Any Position in Salt Lake City, Utah' (Costco self-operates facilities here).
Costco's own locator places the SLC-area retail club (#622 'West Valley') at a DIFFERENT address, confirming 5995 W 300 S is the depot/DC, not a store-mislabel.

verification.rationale: 5995 W 300 S is Costco's Intermountain West depot (#584/585) with by-appointment receiving; distinct from the West Valley retail club #622; no closure/relocation/WARN found.

sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster coords (39.377205, -77.27655) landed on the NE edge of the campus, near
the neighboring light-industrial buildings. Wide z15/z16 satellite probes
resolved the actual depot: a very large NW-SE cross-dock building plus a second
large building to the south, ringed by forest and farmland, set well back from
US-40/Old National Pike, with a residential subdivision to the south. True
campus center is ~39.3754, -77.2805. Identity confirmed by the street address,
the 84-acre / ~300-bay cooler-freezer GC project record, and multiple trucker
reviews naming "Costco Distribution Center, 5236 Intercoastal Dr, Monrovia."

Imagery currency: the most recent satellite (Airbus/Maxar 2026) and Street View
(2024-07) both show the facility fully built and operating; the 2024 Street View
also shows active expansion/construction near the NE entrance and visitor lot.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed controlled truck entrance. Street View at the property entrance shows a 'TRUCK ENTRANCE ONLY' sign and directional lane arrows where the truck route splits from the visitor/employee road; public Street View coverage stops abruptly at the entrance throat (private road beyond), consistent with a gated facility. Trucker reviews (TruckersReport / TruckMap) describe checking in 'at the gate' with on-site security.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Driver reviews explicitly describe being 'greeted by very friendly security' at the gate and note 'the yard drivers don't have radios to the gate' - confirming a staffed check-in gate. The booth itself sits inside the private entrance throat (~39.3766,-77.2777) beyond public Street View; a small structure cluster is visible near the entrance in satellite.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - the gate is staffed by security per driver reports, so this is a manned guard shack rather than a remote kiosk/call-box check-in.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Driver reviews note 'curb parking outside the gate for waiting on dispatch' and a food truck; the wide paved approach apron and shoulder near the entrance junction provide truck-sized waiting room outside the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved holding aprons inside the property between the gate and the dock faces; trucks queue on the internal loop road and yard apron before being paged to a door.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the NE entrance throat down to the dock faces (several hundred meters of paved truck road around the building) - easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single truck entrance/exit point on the NE side off the Intercoastal Dr internal road; no separate dedicated out-gate observed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1-2 inbound lanes at the gate; exact count not resolvable - the booth is past public Street View and the entrance throat is partly under construction in the 2024 imagery.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated; exit shares the same entrance throat (entry/exit together).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron and multi-lane paved junction at the NE entrance with ample unused paved width to add an appointment/express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ is firm. Driver reviews reference dock doors numbered in the 500-553 range, and the main cross-dock building has continuous dock doors with trailers backed in along BOTH long faces. 260 is an honest overhead estimate across both faces of the main building plus the south building; band 50+ is certain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ is firm. Hundreds of trailers parked in long angled rows fill the SW drop yard, the central yard, and a north drop area - clearly a large dedicated drop/spotter-yard operation (yard drivers mentioned in reviews).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: The main cross-dock has dock banks on both opposite long faces (NE and SW), and there is a second large building (south) with its own dock face - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town/rural setting: the 84-acre campus is ringed by forest and farmland, set well back from US-40/Old National Pike, with a residential subdivision to the south. Some neighboring light-industrial buildings sit to the NE but the broader setting is rural. Per the rubric tie-breaker, classed Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: False - despite the rural setting it is a major active DC near I-70/US-40 in the Frederick metro fringe; cellular coverage is adequate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - two distinct large buildings on one campus: the long NW-SE cross-dock depot and a separate large rectangular building to the south, plus ancillary canopy/shop structures.
fieldNotes.scale: Not clearly visible in available imagery; possible scale within the private entrance throat but not confirmed - left false, listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: True - extensive dedicated trailer-storage rows separate from the active dock aprons, full of parked drop trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~84 acres per the GC project record (Novak Construction), consistent with the traced perimeter.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~450 trailers visible across drop yards and dock faces in the captured imagery; honest overhead estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.imageryNote: Most recent satellite (Airbus/Maxar 2026) and Street View (2024-07) both show the facility built and operating, with some active expansion/construction near the NE entrance and visitor lot in the 2024 Street View.

citations.claim: GC Novak built Costco's Monrovia MD depot: ground-up precast DC on 84 acres, ~300 truck bays, dry + cooler/freezer, with a 27-acre e-comm/returns center completed fall 2018.
Frederick County coverage: Costco's EXISTING Monrovia DC is being expanded with a new 593,400 sq ft e-comm/returns building (existing depot operates; new build is an addition).

verification.rationale: Monrovia depot (Depot 171) at 5236 Intercoastal Dr is a built, operating Mid-Atlantic refrigerated cross-dock (DC operational since ~2010, e-comm done 2018, active in 2023); the 2023 'new warehouse' approval is an expansion building, not the original depot.
